verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an up Riposte or let her free-poke you with double Lunge; you win if you bait the parry first and start fights with W instead of an auto.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) only ever reflects a basic attack - it cannot touch an ability. That means K'Sante's hard CC (W stun, the Q shockwave pull at 2 stacks, R's knockback) goes through Riposte completely untouched. The whole lane comes down to whether K'Sante opens with an ability or an auto-attack.

theirWindow.when: after she lands Q (Lunge) and pops E
theirWindow.what: Burst of Speed stacks attack speed and grants move speed on every landed hit or Lunge, so she can stick to you and out-trade autos. Don't try to walk away and auto through it - hold E (Footwork) shield for the stick and wait out the duration before re-engaging.

yourWindow.what: Lunge can recast once for free within a couple seconds, but once both are spent she has zero gap-close for the rest of its cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s). That's when you walk her down and land W (Path Maker) - the stun can't be Riposted.

both ults live, first CC lands wins fight

start.why: blunts the repeated poke from Lunge and the passive healing she racks up off every hit landed on you

boots.why: she deals almost all her damage through basic attacks, so flat reduction on autos hits her hardest

core.why: rewards hitting an isolated target with shield and heal, which is exactly what a 1v1 top lane duel against her is
Q (Ntofo Strikes) proccing the slow on-hit repeatedly makes it much harder for her to reset spacing after Lunge
the reflect damage plus the healing reduction it applies to whoever hits you directly undercuts her Duelist sustain

the enemy team has heavy magic damage stacked around her
she's building crit and the attack speed slow on hit would blunt her duel damage

runes.keystoneWhy: extended melee trades against a duelist reward the max-health scaling and sustain per proc more than a burst keystone does

summoners.why: Flash lets you force a W stun or R knockback she can't dodge, and Teleport keeps you relevant on the map since this lane is decided by cooldown windows, not permanent kill pressure

playing.title: Bait Riposte before committing
playing.detail: Throw out a spare auto or a Q poke from range first. If she pops W (Riposte) on it, her AD steroid and parry are both spent for the next 6-10s and your real all-in is now free.

playing.title: Open fights with W, not autos
playing.detail: Path Maker's stun cannot be reflected by Riposte since it only works against a basic attack. Always engage with the ability, then follow up with autos once she's locked down.

playing.title: Count her Lunge casts
playing.detail: Lunge has a free recast within a couple seconds. Don't burn your E (Footwork) shield on the first dash - wait to see if the second one is coming before you decide to commit.

playing.title: Stack Q for the pull
playing.detail: Two stacks of Ntofo Strikes fires a shockwave that pulls her in. Use it to punish her after she disengages with the move speed from Burst of Speed.

playing.title: Freeze the wave near your tower
playing.detail: Removing her runway denies the space Lunge needs to poke you safely and forces her to walk up into your Q's slow line instead.

playing.title: Track R cooldown gaps
playing.detail: By rank 3, your R (All Out) is up on a 80s cooldown against her 110s Blade Waltz. Use every window where your ult is up and hers isn't to force an all-in through the wall - she has no ultimate answer to it.
